items.title: Warren Vaché interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 23, 1995
items.q: for the next ten years or so on and off, I worked with Benny Goodman off and on in varying combinations.

ctx.x: Tell us how you moved out of the, more on to the national scene from the New York area, and did you have a couple of big breaks along the way or was it a gradual —

I was just very fortunate in being in the right place at the right time in a lot of instances. Right after the Bix Beiderbecke concert, Benny Goodman was looking for a trumpet player. And again, Bucky Pizzarelli recommended me. John Bunch recommended me. And the next thing I knew I found myself on a plane going somewhere in New Hampshire to play with Benny Goodman. No rehearsal, no nothing.
